_comment: "When this hits a PIRATE HERO, {t} them or an ally they control." Both halves named the wrong thing. The gate was ATTACK_CLASS_IN pirate, which asks whether the ATTACK CARD is a Pirate card -- this card is a Pirate attack, so the gate was true whoever it hit, and the class of the hero being hit was never checked at all. The effect was TAP_REF over a ref named 'ATTACKER' that nothing anywhere stores, so it tapped nothing. "Them or an ally they control" is a choice between objects, so it is an object target over the opponent's HERO and ARENA zones rather than one of TAP's fixed shorthands.
